findings.label: Diagnosis reversal vs. plan
findings.detail: The plan's 'CONFIRMED connection pinning' diagnosis for Fix 1 was overturned at implementation time; the committed baseline and verification document why (did not reproduce under measurement at concurrency 1 and 6; customHeaders Connection:close is schema-rejected HTTP 400 and is a no-op hop-by-hop header). The load-spread acceptance criterion is met by the post-change 7-minute evidence (all 4 replicas carry load, max/min < 2x), so this is a documentation/judgment note, not a blocker.

findings.label: Residual latency tail persists (driver-level, out of scope)
findings.detail: 0.08% of requests (3/3792) hit the 60s client ceiling due to the un-fixed Intel Arc i915 fence-expiration stall; all still return 200 via OmniRoute requestRetry:3. Elimination requires the reboot Phase B (GuC tuning or i915-sriov-dkms bump), which is correctly scoped out of this task.
